mapper.select: select activity_id, activity_name, discount_id, stock_count, remain_count, take_limit_count, status, start_time, end_time, tag_id, tag_scope from seckill_activity where activity_id = #{activityId}

select activity_id, activity_name, discount_id, stock_count, remain_count, take_limit_count, status, start_time, end_time, tag_id, tag_scope from seckill_activity where status = 1 and start_time <= NOW() and end_time >= NOW()
mapper.update: update seckill_activity set remain_count = remain_count - 1 where activity_id = #{activityId} and remain_count > 0
update seckill_activity set remain_count = remain_count + 1 where activity_id = #{activityId} and remain_count < stock_count
